## Summary

Describe the smallest user-visible change.

## Safety and privacy checklist

- [ ] No credentials, private media, model weights, chat history or machine paths were added.
- [ ] Permission and audit invariants are preserved.
- [ ] Skill promotion/rollback remains user-gated.
- [ ] Provider-specific code stays behind the public interfaces.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Tests or documentation updated as needed.
